svg.title: Cutoffs move a lot between calibrations, so they need the full train split
svg.desc: Per-class confidence cutoff that reaches 95% held-out accuracy (five-fold cross-fit). With no wrong answers, the cutoff is just the lowest confidence of a right answer, so small draws set it.

g.text: Cutoffs move a lot between calibrations, so they need the full train split
Per-class confidence cutoff that reaches 95% held-out accuracy (five-fold cross-fit). With no wrong answers, the cutoff
is just the lowest confidence of a right answer, so small draws set it.
